title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - Participant
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/Participant. A legal or natural person that is onboarded to Gaia-X and offers, consumes services or operates resources. Subclass of GaiaXEntity per the Gaia-X ontology; declares no properties of its own beyond those inherited (documented on the GaiaXEntity model). The source ontology marks this class as abstract, not intended for direct instantiation -- included here per the full-ontology translation scope; the concrete Gaia-X participant subtype is LegalPerson.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Participant'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
